title: Forward Scan Boundary Turn
statement: Let $W$ and $M$ be finite Turing machines over Boolean symbols, let $a$ be a natural number, and let $x$ be a schedule-alphabet input. Suppose the base guide tape equals the guide of radius $R$. From the forward phase with guide head at $R+1$, one simulator step enters the backward phase with guide head at $R$ and resets every neighbor register to the blank payload; the state, answer bit, saved reads, data tapes, and output are unchanged.
